ios.heading: ON IPHONE & IPAD (SAFARI)
steps: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari (the square with an arrow).
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
Open the app from your home screen, just like any other app.

android.heading: ON ANDROID (CHROME)
steps: Tap the three-dot menu in the top-right of Chrome.
Open the app from your home screen, just like any other app.

desktop.heading: ON YOUR COMPUTER
steps: Open the app using the button below.
